name: Talk steps (Amir 10-31)
note: Steps in the order of the tree; Run 3 left, HL-LHC right.

views.name: 1.1: the trigger we have
views.note: The standard trigger with its thresholds raised to the budget, and the same trigger prescaled. The HL-LHC prescaled menu exists only on the 350 kHz Level-1 stage.

views.name: 1.2: hashing without physics or signal
views.note: Random planes on the trigger's quantities do not work and are drawn as a reference; planes placed at the tails of the background distributions are the best hashing that uses neither physics nor signal.

views.name: 1.3: hashing with physics placing the planes
views.note: Hashing with the planes at the menu's own thresholds: physics places the planes. On Run 3, six tables, one per object type.

views.name: 2.1: a fitted density of the trigger's quantities
views.note: A Gaussian with its full covariance fitted to the trigger's quantities, beside tail-quantile hashing.

views.name: 3.1: a score that is not a density, as references
views.note: Scores that do not estimate the background density: an autoencoder or AXOL1TL, and a classifier trained on signal. Drawn as references.

views.name: 3.2: signal placing the planes on the trigger's quantities
views.note: Hashing with planes chosen with known signals, refitted, or boosted across tables, the best of each; the classifier is the reference.

views.name: 4.1: a fitted density of a learned representation
views.note: The best fitted density on each learned representation: an autoencoder's latent or AXOL1TL's, a classifier's output, a contrastive embedding.

views.note: Hashing on each learned representation with planes that use no signal: random or tail-quantile planes, or planes from the covariance.

views.name: 4.4: unique capture: what the standard trigger does not take
views.note: The capture the standard trigger does not make: beyond it at its full rate, and beyond the raised menu at the same rate; never against the prescaled menu. On Run 3 both are measured for hashing on the contrastive embedding; on HL-LHC the embedding has the full-rate comparison only, the same-rate one against the raised menu is not yet measured there.

views.note: The standard trigger keeps (1 − f) of the rate and novelty takes f; the capture of the two together.
